title: Colour season questionnaire
description: Questions on the Colour tab. Each answer moves the person's scores on the warmth, depth and clarity axes of data/colour-seasons.json; the average of every answered question decides the suggestion. Answers are kept only while the tab is open.

id.description: Stable id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

help.description: Optional hint on how to answer it.

photo.description: If set, photo sampling can suggest an answer: skin, hair and eyes pick the option whose hex is nearest the sampled colour; undertone and contrast are worked out from the samples by the app.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the question. The app's photo code refers to the ids of undertone and contrast options.

hex.description: Typical colour for this answer, shown as a swatch and matched against photo samples.

warmth.description: How this answer moves warmth: -1 cool to 1 warm. Leave out if it says nothing about warmth.

depth.description: How this answer moves depth: -1 light to 1 deep.

clarity.description: How this answer moves clarity: -1 soft to 1 bright.
